fieldNotes.truckGate: Open urban plant integrated into the city street grid. Street View at the main entrance drive (pano rDyZ6MJsoWbAtfyRjfSPCA, 2022-07) and along Depot St shows open driveways into the complex with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. No fence line controlling the truck approach.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. Entry drives open straight into employee parking / internal yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Central internal drive runs the length of the complex NW-SE and can stack several trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Entrances open directly off narrow public urban streets (Depot St) with on-street parking and tight geometry; a truck queue would spill onto the street.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted across multiple building faces and trailers backed in; ~30-40 doors total, banded 25-50 (estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Central drive holds a row of ~10-12 angled drop trailers without tractors; banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~6 distinct connected/adjacent large buildings (manufacturing, warehouse, office) plus a separate white warehouse to the south.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated row of parked drop trailers along the central internal drive.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur entering the property in current imagery (old rail lines run nearby in the corridor but do not serve docks).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple dock banks on different faces, but cannot confirm a deliberate ship/receive split from overhead; left false, flagged uncertain.
